integrity: Analytic proof by affine reduction, exact conditional integrals, multinomial decomposition, and strict pair-averaging; standalone SymPy and NumPy verifier reproduces critical identities and independent geometric samples. The independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: For nondegenerate Euclidean triangles only. Exact population capture probability, not finite-sample statistical inference. Previous sources already provide the equilateral constant and the one-point-per-side conditional constant; the new claims are arbitrary edge-weight formula, arclength shape law, majorization, and sharp infimum. Historical priority remains provisional; full Halasz--Kleitman 1974 text was inaccessible.
title: Sharp centroid-containment law for boundary-sampled triangles
